notes.title: Update Notes for 2.96
notes.content: We've released this version with optimizations and bug fixes to meet full GREEN CHECKMARK Steam Deck Verification. Were super excited to have the game recognized as fully playable on Steam Deck and hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Small update - bug fix - version 2.92
notes.content:
Third time is hopefully a charm!

Version 2.92 Notes
- Hoping this fixes the black screen issue that was reported as still happening
- This fix may also fix the endless loading error that was reported by a player

Thanks for the patience as we work on resolving these issues!

notes.title: Small update - bug fix - version 2.91
notes.content:
This patch should fix the black screen issue that a couple of users have reported.

Thanks for reporting on the forums!

notes.title: Endless Mode Update!
notes.content:
- Added a bunch more Endless chunks
- Endless Mode difficulty balancing
- Stacking score "floaties"
- Rogue wildlife that run down no longer die unfairly
- Sweet new ghosts effect when you lose your streak (sadface)

notes.title: Small update - bug fix - version 2.82
notes.content: Version 2.82 fixes an issue with two level solutions not working properly.

notes.title: Bug fixes and polish - version 2.81
notes.content:
First of all, thank you so much to everyone who has played the game so far! Also, thanks for posting reviews and comments/potential bugs in the forums! Your support helps us make the game better.

If you have been enjoying the game, please leave us a review! The team is reading all your feedback and it is truly appreciated.

Patch Notes - Version 2.81
[list]
[*] Achievements now validate on startup - re-launching game should fire any missing achievements
[*] Fixed lingering Endless multiplier floaties
[*] Improved settings menu navigation for controllers
[*] Split out Accessibility options
[*] Settings UI art polish
[*] Improved randomization of minigames
[/list]

Note: we have another bug reported of an issue with a level / level solution - we are looking into it now!

notes.title: Slayaway Camp 2 is AVAILABLE NOW!!!
notes.content:
Slayaway Camp 2 is AVAILABLE NOW!!! 

Welcome to The Most Violentest Puzzle Game Ever Made!

- Hack and slash your way through hundreds of devilishly designed slasher puzzle levels!
- Unlock new murder mechanics while you play as a variety of terrifying killers!
- Test your reflexes with brutally fun minigames! 
- Steam Deck exclusive minigames that actually use those weird buttons on the back! Gouge eyes! Strangle dudes!
- Challenge yourself in Endless Mode until you’re ready to gouge your own eyes out!
- BRAND NEW Endless Leaderboards! See if you can beat the dev's high score :) 
- An all-new killer original soundtrack by weird indie Canadian band Ghost Cartridge


We hope you love the game!
